speaker: Sofia
text: Hi, welcome to your first week! I'm Sofia, your manager, and with me are Tom from IT and Nadia from HR.

speaker: Nadia
text: Welcome aboard. We'll go through the essentials in about four minutes, promise.

speaker: Tom
text: Let's start with your accounts. Everything runs through SSO, so you only have one password to remember.

speaker: Tom
text: On top of that, MFA is mandatory: you'll approve each new login on your phone.

speaker: Sofia
text: Is the authenticator app already set up on the new laptop?

speaker: Tom
text: Yes. When you work from home, connect to the VPN before opening any internal tool.

speaker: Tom
text: We also follow least privilege: you get access to what your role needs, and you can request more through the help desk.

speaker: Tom
text: And watch out for emails asking for your password. We run a phishing simulation every month to keep everyone sharp.

speaker: Nadia
text: On my side, there are a few things about personal data.

speaker: Nadia
text: Because we have customers in Europe, all customer data falls under GDPR, so never export it to a personal drive.

speaker: Nadia
text: If you're unsure, ask our DPO before sharing anything outside the company.

speaker: Nadia
text: Holidays are booked as PTO in the HR portal, at least two weeks in advance.

speaker: Nadia
text: {listener}, could you complete the security and GDPR training modules before Friday?

speaker: Nadia
text: Great, thanks. They take about forty minutes in total.

speaker: Sofia
text: Now the team side. Every quarter we set OKRs, so everyone knows what matters most.

speaker: Sofia
text: This quarter, our main objective is to cut support ticket volume by twenty percent.

speaker: Sofia
text: Progress is tracked with a few KPIs, like first response time and customer satisfaction.

speaker: Sofia
text: For big customers we also have an SLA: we must answer critical tickets within one hour.

speaker: Tom
text: Which is why we have an on-call rotation for nights and weekends.

speaker: Sofia
text: Don't worry, you won't join the rotation before your third month.

speaker: Sofia
text: When something breaks, we write a blameless postmortem: what happened, why, and how we prevent it, without pointing fingers.

speaker: Tom
text: The template is in the wiki, under Engineering.

speaker: Sofia
text: For decisions that involve several teams, we use a RACI chart so it's clear who decides and who just needs to know.

speaker: Nadia
text: And once a month there's an all-hands where the leadership shares results and answers questions.

speaker: Sofia
text: Your onboarding buddy is Karim, who'll show you around the codebase and the support tools.

speaker: Sofia
text: {listener}, could you set up a first one-on-one with me for next Tuesday?

speaker: Sofia
text: Perfect. We'll use it to agree on your goals for the first ninety days.

speaker: Tom
text: Last thing from me: if your laptop acts up, open a ticket instead of messaging me directly.

speaker: Nadia
text: And our door is always open, even for the small questions.

speaker: Sofia
text: Welcome again. Lunch with the team is at noon!
